exposure: maternal bisphenol A (BPA) concentration in urine
maternal bisphenol S concentration in urine
maternal bisphenol F (BPF) concentration in urine
cohort: A total of 826 mother-offspring pairs were recruited from Wuhan Children's Hospital between November 2013 and March 2015.
finding: Prenatal exposure to BPA during the second trimester and BPF during the third trimester were associated with an increased likelihood of a low-increasing BMI trajectory in offspring during the first two years.
